sessions.title: AI Agents: The Next Generation of Software
sessions.speaker: Anna Müller
sessions.speakerBio: Anna works on intelligent developer platforms and production AI systems, with a focus on agentic workflows and human-in-the-loop applications.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · Ground Floor, East Wing
sessions.description: AI agents are moving from experimental prototypes into production systems. This session explores how modern agent architectures work, where they deliver real business value, and the engineering challenges teams face when deploying reliable autonomous workflows.

sessions.title: Next-Gen Quantum Computing & Cryptography
sessions.speaker: Dr. Lukas Weber
sessions.speakerBio: Lukas leads applied quantum research and advises industry on post-quantum cryptography migration.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · First Floor, North Wing
sessions.description: Where quantum hardware really stands today, and what engineering teams should do now to prepare their systems for post-quantum cryptography.

sessions.title: Scaling Cross-Platform Mobile Architectures
sessions.speaker: Elena Rostova
sessions.speakerBio: Elena builds mobile platforms used by millions and maintains several open-source Flutter packages.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · Ground Floor, East Wing
sessions.description: Modular architecture, state management and release pipelines for cross-platform apps that need to grow with large teams.

sessions.title: Autonomous Robotics & Industrial Automation
sessions.speaker: Marcus Lindemann
sessions.speakerBio: Marcus researches autonomous systems for manufacturing and logistics at the Technical University of Munich.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · Ground Floor, West Wing
sessions.description: From research lab to factory floor: how autonomous robots are being deployed safely alongside human workers.

sessions.title: Building Resilient European Tech Ecosystems
sessions.speaker: Dr. Sophie von Berg
sessions.speakerBio: Sophie invests in early-stage deep tech companies across Europe.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · Ground Floor, East Wing
sessions.description: Founders, investors and policy makers discuss what Europe needs to grow and keep its next generation of tech companies.

sessions.title: Green Cloud Computing & Low-Power Datacenters
sessions.speaker: Florian Bauer
sessions.speakerBio: Florian designs energy-efficient cloud infrastructure for European data centres.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · First Floor, North Wing
sessions.description: Practical techniques for cutting the energy use and carbon footprint of cloud workloads without hurting performance.

sessions.title: Building Reliable AI Agents in Production
sessions.speaker: Jonas Weber
sessions.speakerBio: Jonas has spent the last decade building distributed systems and now leads the agent platform team at CloudNative.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · First Floor, North Wing
sessions.description: Retries, timeouts, evaluation and observability: the unglamorous engineering that turns an impressive agent demo into a service you can trust.

sessions.title: Privacy by Design in Mobile Apps
sessions.speaker: Mira Hoffmann
sessions.speakerBio: Mira helps product teams ship apps that meet GDPR requirements without slowing development down.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · Ground Floor, West Wing
sessions.description: How to collect less data, store it safely on the device and explain clearly to users what happens with it.

sessions.title: Edge AI on Embedded Devices
sessions.speaker: Elena Klein
sessions.speakerBio: Elena's team runs machine learning models on low-power hardware for automotive and industrial customers.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · Ground Floor, West Wing
sessions.description: Shrinking models to fit microcontrollers: quantisation, pruning and the trade-offs between accuracy, latency and battery life.

sessions.title: Design Systems That Scale Across Platforms
sessions.speaker: Clara Schmidt
sessions.speakerBio: Clara builds design systems shared by web, iOS and Android teams.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · Ground Floor, East Wing
sessions.description: Tokens, components and documentation: keeping designers and developers in sync as a product grows.

sessions.title: The Future of Mobility in Bavaria
sessions.speaker: Prof. Thomas Becker
sessions.speakerBio: Thomas researches connected and electric mobility and advises regional government on transport strategy.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · Ground Floor, East Wing
sessions.description: Electric vehicles, autonomous shuttles and smarter public transport: what the region's roads will look like by 2035.

sessions.title: Testing Flutter Apps Without the Pain
sessions.speaker: Tomás García
sessions.speakerBio: Tomás maintains a large Flutter codebase and speaks regularly about testing and CI.
sessions.venue: MunichTech EXPO Center · First Floor, North Wing
sessions.description: Unit, widget and integration tests: what to test, what to skip and how to keep the suite fast in CI.
